fixtures.name: Root number promoted to exact rank
fixtures.missing_obligation: The sign fixes parity only; an upper bound or nonvanishing statement is missing.
fixtures.witness: Orders 1, 3, 5, and higher odd values have the same parity.
fixtures.remediation: Supply a certified order-of-vanishing bound and the required analytic/arithmetic bridge.

fixtures.name: Numerical near-zero promoted to exact vanishing
fixtures.invalid_inference: A small computed L(E,1) or derivative proves exact zero.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Floating-point evaluation supplies neither exact vanishing nor an exclusion of higher order.
fixtures.witness: Finite precision cannot distinguish zero from a sufficiently small nonzero value.
fixtures.remediation: Use rigorous interval bounds, exact modular-symbol methods, or a theorem-grade analytic-rank certificate.

fixtures.name: Finite derivative sample promoted to exact analytic order
fixtures.invalid_inference: The first numerically nonzero sampled derivative determines ord at s=1.
fixtures.missing_obligation: All lower derivatives require certified zero statements and the selected derivative requires certified nonzero.
fixtures.witness: Sampling and truncation error can change both conclusions.
fixtures.remediation: Produce certified Taylor-coefficient bounds in the fixed complete-L normalization.

fixtures.name: Selmer corank identified with Mordell–Weil rank
fixtures.missing_obligation: The divisible p-primary Sha contribution is uncontrolled.
fixtures.witness: The Kummer exact sequence gives corank Selmer = rank E(Q) + corank Sha[p-infinity].
fixtures.remediation: Prove finiteness or zero corank of Sha[p-infinity], then apply the exact sequence.

fixtures.name: One p-primary Sha component promoted to full Sha finiteness
fixtures.invalid_inference: Sha[p-infinity] finite for one p implies Sha finite.
fixtures.witness: A torsion group may have finite p-primary part and infinite q-primary part.
fixtures.remediation: Control every primary component or invoke a theorem proving global finiteness.

fixtures.name: One p-part promoted to the full leading-term formula
fixtures.invalid_inference: A p-adic valuation identity for one prime proves BSD-LEAD-Q.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Prime-to-p factors and exact rational equality remain undetermined.
fixtures.witness: Equal p-adic valuations do not determine a rational number.
fixtures.remediation: Assemble all prime parts plus sign and normalization data, or use a complete-formula theorem.

fixtures.name: p-adic order promoted to complex analytic order
fixtures.missing_obligation: No named comparison or p-converse theorem is supplied.
fixtures.witness: Exceptional zeros and signed supersingular functions can change the p-adic order.
fixtures.remediation: Name and verify a branch-specific comparison or converse theorem.

fixtures.name: Ordinary theorem transferred to multiplicative or supersingular reduction
fixtures.invalid_inference: A good-ordinary main-conjecture theorem applies unchanged at every prime.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Local conditions, interpolation factors, and exceptional-zero corrections differ.
fixtures.witness: Split multiplicative and supersingular theories use materially different objects.
fixtures.remediation: Restate the theorem in the correct reduction branch and discharge its local hypotheses.

fixtures.name: Primitive and imprimitive Euler products silently interchanged
fixtures.invalid_inference: An imprimitive formula has the same leading coefficient as the primitive formula.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Removed local factors can change the leading coefficient and valuation.
fixtures.witness: Finite nonzero factors preserve order but rescale the coefficient.
fixtures.remediation: Insert the omitted Euler factors explicitly and recompute the coefficient.

fixtures.name: Incomplete and complete complex L-functions silently interchanged
fixtures.invalid_inference: Wiles's initially incomplete Euler product can be inserted directly into the modern Tamagawa formula.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The omitted bad-prime factors rescale the leading coefficient.
fixtures.witness: Order of vanishing may agree while the coefficient differs.
fixtures.remediation: Use the complete finite L-function or record the exact conversion multiplier.

fixtures.name: Period or isogeny normalization drift
fixtures.invalid_inference: Omega_E, Omega_E-plus, an optimal-curve period, and a nonminimal-differential period are interchangeable.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Component, Manin-constant, differential, and isogeny factors are missing.
fixtures.witness: Isogenous curves can have different displayed periods and local factors while satisfying compatible formulas.
fixtures.remediation: Bind the theorem to the registry normalization and state every conversion factor.

fixtures.name: Rank-one Euler-system mechanism extrapolated to higher rank
fixtures.invalid_inference: One non-torsion Heegner point or one Kolyvagin-system direction proves arbitrary-rank BSD.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Higher rank requires several independent classes and determinant-level height control.
fixtures.witness: A single class spans at most one rational direction.
fixtures.remediation: Provide an exterior-power or derived-height mechanism with independence and nondegeneracy proofs.

fixtures.name: Parity plus an unproved upper bound promoted to exact rank
fixtures.invalid_inference: Parity and a heuristic Selmer or rank bound determine the exact rank.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The upper bound is not theorem-grade or still contains Sha.
fixtures.witness: Parity only selects a congruence class.
fixtures.remediation: Certify the upper bound and identify whether it bounds Mordell–Weil rank, Selmer corank, or analytic order.

fixtures.name: Family or positive-proportion theorem promoted to universality
fixtures.invalid_inference: BSD holds for a positive proportion or infinitely many twists, therefore it holds for all E/Q.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The universal quantifier is not discharged.
fixtures.witness: An infinite proper subset can omit infinitely many curves.
fixtures.remediation: Retain the exact family and density quantifier.

fixtures.name: Finite database promoted to universality
fixtures.invalid_inference: A rigorous computation below conductor B proves BSD for every elliptic curve.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Curves above the bound are untreated.
fixtures.witness: A finite verification cannot discharge an infinite universal domain.
fixtures.remediation: Report an individual or finite-range certificate only.

fixtures.name: Height nondegeneracy assumed at the decisive step
fixtures.invalid_inference: A derived or p-adic height regulator is nonzero because the expected rank is r.
fixtures.missing_obligation: Nondegeneracy is itself an open or theorem-specific obligation.
fixtures.witness: A bilinear form may be degenerate on a nonzero space.
fixtures.remediation: Prove nondegeneracy under explicit hypotheses or keep the conclusion conditional.

fixtures.name: Selmer local conditions changed without notice
fixtures.invalid_inference: A theorem for a Bloch–Kato, Greenberg, signed, strict, or relaxed Selmer group applies to another Selmer group.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The comparison of local conditions and correction terms is absent.
fixtures.witness: Changing one local condition can change corank and characteristic ideal.
fixtures.remediation: Name the Selmer structure and prove the comparison exact sequence.

fixtures.name: Circular BSD computation
fixtures.invalid_inference: BSD is used to infer rank or Sha and the inferred value is then presented as evidence for BSD.
fixtures.missing_obligation: The conclusion is already embedded in the input assumption.
fixtures.witness: A conditional calculator can reproduce its assumption without independent evidence.
fixtures.remediation: Separate unconditional inputs, conditional outputs, and independent verification.
